title: Laplacian U-Processes for Multiple Change-Point Detection in Dependent Text Networks: An Application to Historical Chinese Articles
summary: We propose a two-view weighted-concordance operator (WCO) framework for offline change-point detection in weakly dependent text networks. Weighted word-co-occurrence graphs yield first-order direct-co-occurrence and second-order shared-context views, projected into paired Euclidean observations using maps learned from an independent pilot corpus. A WCO scan detects changes in cross-view dependence. A dependent multiplier bootstrap tests for a change, while a segment-wise block bootstrap gives a descriptive stability interval for its location.
